description: This file defines the SugarFeed class, which manages user activity feeds, including functions for activating, deactivating, retrieving modules, pushing feed items, handling links, and rendering feed data in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: SugarFeed
classes.description: Represents and manages the user activity feed, providing methods for activation, deactivation, fetching feeds, pushing new entries, handling links, and rendering feed data.

methods.name: activateModuleFeed
methods.description: Activates the feed for a specified module and updates the database setting accordingly.

methods.name: disableModuleFeed
methods.description: Deactivates the feed for a specified module and updates the database setting accordingly.

methods.name: flushBackendCache
methods.description: Clears cache files related to the SugarFeed modules and link types.

methods.name: getModuleFeedFiles
methods.description: Retrieves list of feed files associated with a specific module.

methods.name: getActiveFeedModules
methods.description: Retrieves list of modules with active feed enabled, using cache or database settings.

methods.name: getAllFeedModules
methods.description: Returns all modules that can have feeds, scanning default and custom directories.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Creates and saves a new feed entry associated with a specific record and module, possibly with link data.

methods.name: pushFeed2
methods.description: Wrapper around pushFeed to simplify creating a feed entry from a bean.

methods.name: getLinkTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available link handler types, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: getLinkClass
methods.description: Given a link type name, loads and returns the corresponding link handler class.

methods.name: getTimeLapse
methods.description: Calculates a human-readable time difference between now and a start date.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Converts URLs in a message text into clickable links.
